PRIA DOCK + PRACTICE AGENT

Copy par har line.
Usi waqt, usi step par madad.

PRIA Dock ka camera bachche ki notebook par likhe steps ko real time mein dekhne ke liye designed hai. Practice Agent har line check karega, taaki use pata chale ki bachcha kis step par atak raha hai.

  1. Bachcha apni copy par solve karega.Dock ke camera se likhe hue steps AI tak pahunchenge.
  2. Galat step par turant guidance milegi.AI usi jagah hint ya explanation dekar dobara try karne mein madad karega.
  3. Agla attempt bhi check hoga.Kahan madad chahiye thi aur kya samajh aaya, yeh Planner aur Revision Agent ke kaam aayega.

Sawaal shuru karne se lekar dobara sahi step try karne tak, bachche ko guidance milti rahegi.

¾ + ½ = ⁴⁄₆

Galat step · denominators bhi jod diye
PRACTICE AGENT KA HINT

“Ruko, neeche ke numbers ko jodna nahi hai. Pehle pieces ek size ke karo. ½ ko kitne quarters likh sakte ho?”

Guidance ke baad agla step dekhiye +

½ = ²⁄₄
¾ + ²⁄₄ = ⁵⁄₄

Yeh step sahi hai. Ab ek naya sawaal, jismein bachcha khud yahi idea apply kare.

LEARNING HISTORY

“Fractions mein
yeh step atak raha hai.”

Notebook ke steps, pichhle answers aur follow-up questions se equivalent fractions ka gap saamne aata hai.

Practice mein dikhaDifferent denominators ko seedha jod diya
Agli learning needEquivalent fractions ko dobara samajhna hai

Agla plan isi learning history se judega.

  1. 1

    PERSONAL PLANNER

    Pehle sahi step ko time milega.

    Agle plan mein equivalent fractions ka short lesson rakhega.

  2. 2

    PERSONALISED LESSON

    Same-size pieces. Ab addition samajhiye.

    ½ ko 2 quarters likh sakte hain. Dono fractions ke pieces ab ek size ke hain.

    ½ = ²⁄₄ ¾ + ½ = ¾ + ²⁄₄ = ⁵⁄₄
  3. 3

    PRACTICE AGENT

    Naye sawaal par wahi step.

    Ab dekhega ki bachcha is idea ko khud apply kar paa raha hai ya nahi.

    ⅓ + ⅙ = ? Check answer

    ⅓ = ²⁄₆. Toh ²⁄₆ + ⅙ = ³⁄₆ = ½.

  4. 4

    REVISION AGENT

    Baad mein, bina hint ke dobara.

    Ek naya question check karega ki concept ab bhi samajh mein hai.

    ⅚ + ⅓ = ? Check answer

    ⅓ = ²⁄₆. Toh ⅚ + ²⁄₆ = ⁷⁄₆.

Practice aur revision ke results phir agle plan ka hissa banenge.

What does the 47-parameter design mean?

The intended design includes emotion, posture and physiological signals such as heart rate. Availability depends on consent, supported devices and validated integrations. Full 47-parameter coverage is not yet verified for launch; these signals do not establish medical diagnoses.

When will my child get access?

Launch is planned for December 2026–January 2027. The introductory month starts when your child’s access is activated. Paying ₹100 now reserves access; it does not unlock learning immediately.

What does my ₹100 payment reserve?

It reserves founding-family access under the published offer. If you continue after the introductory month, your ₹100 is credited to the first paid bill. It is an advance payment, not an additional discount.

What is exclusive to founding families?

The six-month discount: ₹100 off each of the first six paid months, saving ₹600 in total. The included introductory month is the standard introductory month, not an extra founding-family month.

What will I pay after the introductory month?

If you choose to continue, your first paid bill is ₹1,299 after the ₹100 reservation credit. The next five paid bills are ₹1,399 each. After those six paid months, the planned price is ₹1,499/month. There is no automatic subscription debit.

Are all the features shown available today?

Into3 is in pre-launch. The examples show the planned experience. Features, activity catalogues and supported devices for the founding cohort will be confirmed. Full 47-parameter RTAE coverage is not yet verified for launch.

What does PRIA Dock do? Is it included in ₹100?

PRIA Dock is designed to give the Practice Agent a real-time view of the steps your child writes in their notebook. The agent can check the working, offer a hint or explanation at a difficult step, and check the next attempt. Recognition depends on a supported setup and clearly visible handwriting. The ₹100 payment reserves founding-family access; the published subscription offer does not specify hardware inclusion. Dock availability, compatibility and any separate price must be confirmed before purchase.

Does the camera read every signal?

No. Available signals depend on parental consent, supported devices and validated integrations. Camera observations, estimates and device measurements are different sources. RTAE does not read thoughts or establish medical diagnoses.

Can I cancel? What if launch is delayed?

You can cancel before the launch deadline for a full ₹100 refund. If Into3 has not launched by 31 January 2027, the ₹100 reservation is fully refundable. Eligible refunds are manually initiated within 24 hours; bank or payment-provider settlement may take additional time. See the reservation-specific terms.

When does this founding offer close?

This founding-offer window closes on 2 November 2026 at 10:31 pm IST. Reservations made during the offer window keep their agreed founding-family terms.
